question.text: A client prefers income stability. Suitable channel:

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 15, 22, 41, 86, and 160 support current income via dividends, interest, or rental income, along with fixed-income regular payments and debt PMS interest income. The Trap: Futures, small-cap-only, and crypto allocations are too volatile to deliver stable income. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A pages 15, 22, 41, 86, and 160; "bond ladders" wording was not found in the source.
